response.sql:
WITH event_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    AVG(spent) AS avg_spent,
    AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining
  FROM budget
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(remaining) AS mean_remaining
  FROM budget
),
event_with_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    e.link_to_event,
    e.avg_spent,
    e.avg_remaining,
    (e.avg_remaining - o.mean_remaining) AS excess_over_mean
  FROM event_stats e
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
)
SELECT 
  link_to_event,
  avg_spent,
  avg_remaining,
  excess_over_mean
FROM event_with_diff
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN excess_over_mean IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  excess_over_mean DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: AVG() ignores NULL values in spent and remaining columns. This is standard SQL behavior and aligns with the request to 'ignore missing values in the averages.'

The 'mean of remaining over all budget lines (each line counted once)' refers to the simple average of the remaining column across all budget rows globally, not a weighted mean or per-event aggregation.
